payroll.label: Payroll
payroll.purpose: Calculate and pay wages, pay over income tax and social security contributions
payroll.dataCategories: Name, address, bank details, tax ID, social security number, salary, tax class, religious affiliation for German church tax
payroll.recipients: Tax adviser or payroll service, tax office, health insurers, bank
payroll.retention: Payroll accounts until the end of the sixth calendar year after the last payment (§ 41(1) EStG), accounting vouchers eight years (§ 147(3) AO)

personnel_records.label: Personnel administration
personnel_records.purpose: Establish, carry out and end employment
personnel_records.dataCategories: Contact details, employment contract, qualifications, leave, absences (sick leave is health data, a special category), appraisals
personnel_records.recipients: Management, line managers, tax adviser, authorities where a law requires it
personnel_records.retention: Until the employment ends, then only what a law requires to be kept or possible claims need; the company sets the exact period

applicants.label: Applications
applicants.dataCategories: Contact details, CV, references, interview notes
applicants.recipients: Management, the hiring department, a recruitment agency where used
applicants.retention: After a rejection only as long as discrimination claims are possible (in Germany to be raised within two months of receiving the rejection, § 15(4) AGG); the company sets the exact period
applicants.legitimateInterests: Defending ourselves against legal claims from a rejected applicant, only for as long as such claims are possible

whistleblowing.label: Whistleblowing channel
whistleblowing.purpose: Receive reports of violations through the internal reporting channel and follow them up
whistleblowing.dataSubjects: People who report, people named in a report, witnesses
whistleblowing.dataCategories: Name and contact details where given, content of the report, which may include data on criminal offences
whistleblowing.recipients: The internal reporting office, a person in the company or an external ombudsperson
whistleblowing.retention: The documentation is erased three years after the procedure ends (§ 11(5) HinSchG)

working_time.label: Working time records
working_time.purpose: Record working hours, settle overtime and leave
working_time.dataCategories: Name, start, end and length of working time, breaks, absences
working_time.retention: Records under § 16(2) ArbZG at least two years, then erased once payroll no longer needs them

customers.label: Customer management
customers.purpose: Make offers, process orders, look after customers
customers.dataSubjects: Customers, contacts at business customers, prospects
customers.dataCategories: Name, contact details, company, orders, correspondence
customers.recipients: Sales, accounts, delivery services, the provider of the customer management software
customers.retention: Until the business relationship ends; business letters six years, invoices as accounting vouchers eight years (§ 257(4) HGB, § 147(3) AO)
customers.legitimateInterests: Working with the contact people at business customers, who are not themselves party to the contract

accounting.label: Accounting
accounting.purpose: Book transactions, issue and pay invoices, prepare the annual accounts
accounting.dataCategories: Name, address, bank details, invoices, payments
accounting.recipients: Tax adviser, tax office, bank, auditor
accounting.retention: Books and annual accounts ten years, accounting vouchers eight years, business letters six years (§ 257(4) HGB, § 147(3) AO)

suppliers.label: Suppliers and purchasing
suppliers.purpose: Order goods and services, manage suppliers
suppliers.dataCategories: Name, contact details, company, orders, bank details
suppliers.retention: Until the business relationship ends; business letters six years, accounting vouchers eight years (§ 257(4) HGB, § 147(3) AO)
suppliers.legitimateInterests: Working with the contact people at suppliers, who are not themselves party to the contract

enquiries.label: Enquiries and customer service
enquiries.dataCategories: Name, contact details, content of the enquiry
enquiries.recipients: Customer service, the department concerned, the provider of the ticket system
enquiries.retention: Until the enquiry is settled, then erased; if it leads to an order, the periods of customer management apply
enquiries.legitimateInterests: Answering people who contact us, including those who are not customers

website.label: Website
website.purpose: Provide the website and protect it against attacks
website.dataCategories: IP address, time, pages visited, browser
website.retention: Logs only as long as operation and security need; the company sets the exact period
website.legitimateInterests: Delivering the website and keeping it safe from attacks (Recital 49)

website_analytics.label: Website analytics and cookies
website_analytics.purpose: Measure how the website is used, or show content of other providers, with tools that store or read information on the visitor's device
website_analytics.dataCategories: Cookie or device identifiers, IP address, pages visited, device information
website_analytics.recipients: The provider of the analytics or marketing tool
website_analytics.retention: As the consent banner states; erased when the visitor withdraws consent

newsletter.label: Newsletter
newsletter.purpose: Inform prospects and customers about offers by email
newsletter.dataCategories: Email address, name, time and proof of consent
newsletter.retention: Until unsubscribed; the proof of consent as long as it is needed to demonstrate the consent (Art. 7(1) GDPR)

social_media.label: Social media
social_media.purpose: Present the company on social networks, answer messages and comments
social_media.dataSubjects: Followers, people who write or comment
social_media.recipients: The platform operator; for the statistics about your page it can be a joint controller with you (Art. 26)
social_media.retention: Messages erased once settled; the company sets the exact period
social_media.legitimateInterests: Presenting the company and answering the people who contact it there

video_meetings.label: Video meetings
video_meetings.purpose: Hold meetings online with staff, customers and partners
video_meetings.dataCategories: Name, email address, image and sound, time of participation
video_meetings.retention: Recordings only where needed, and erased once the purpose is met; the company sets the exact period
video_meetings.legitimateInterests: Holding meetings with outside participants without travel

email.label: Email
email.dataSubjects: Staff, customers, suppliers and anyone who writes to the company
email.dataCategories: Name, email address, content of messages, attachments
email.retention: Business letters six years, accounting vouchers eight years (§ 257(4) HGB, § 147(3) AO); everything else erased once the purpose is met
email.legitimateInterests: Writing with business contacts who are not themselves party to a contract with us

it_logging.label: IT logs
it_logging.purpose: Run systems, find faults, detect attacks
it_logging.dataSubjects: Staff and other users of the systems
it_logging.dataCategories: User name, IP address, time, sign-ins, actions in the system
it_logging.retention: Only as long as security and troubleshooting need; the company sets the exact period
it_logging.legitimateInterests: Keeping our systems and data safe from attacks and failures (Recital 49). Logs are not used to check how individual staff work.

phishing_tests.label: Phishing tests
phishing_tests.purpose: Test whether staff recognise phishing emails, and train them
phishing_tests.dataCategories: Name, email address, whether a test email was opened, clicked or reported
phishing_tests.recipients: IT department, the provider of the test platform
phishing_tests.retention: Results per person only as long as the training needs them; the company sets the exact period
phishing_tests.legitimateInterests: Protecting our systems against phishing, which works only if staff recognise it. Results are used for training, not to judge individuals.

access_control.label: Access control
access_control.purpose: Control access to buildings and rooms
access_control.dataCategories: Name, badge number, access rights, time of access
access_control.retention: Access rights until the authorisation ends, logs only briefly; the company sets the exact period
access_control.legitimateInterests: Protecting buildings, equipment and data against entry by people who have no business there

video_surveillance.label: Video surveillance
video_surveillance.purpose: Protect buildings and grounds, investigate incidents
video_surveillance.dataSubjects: Staff, visitors, passers-by in the area covered
video_surveillance.recipients: Management, the camera provider where footage is stored in its cloud, in individual cases the police
video_surveillance.retention: As briefly as possible, only until it is clear whether an incident occurred; the company sets the exact period
video_surveillance.legitimateInterests: Protecting property and people and clearing up incidents, where milder means are not enough
